# Handoff

## What is true now

The practice screen is a call. The sunflower sits in the frame. Record, Start, and Camera are the dock. Start is the light button. End replaces it once the session has begun, and it is the red one. Feedback opens the saved profile. The side panel names the scenario, then the two things to try after a report.

Apple-style chrome on the call: system type, press on the way down, translucent dock and side panel, a window instead of an empty field. The line that only explained the empty advice panel is gone.

## Next step

Push is aimed at `main`. Confirm the call still starts, records, and opens Feedback after the merge with the garden and voice-review commits.
